content:
harry_payments: Chargeback alert: processor case PC-2026-APR-447 for $89.00 on acct ACCT-1142. Reason code: 'product not received' (cardholder disputes). This is a subscription to Premium API (monthly). Processor requests proof of delivery and a merchant statement by 2026-04-16T20:00Z. Can we compile evidence?

processor-bot: Automated: Dispute opened (case=PC-2026-APR-447) amount=$89.00. Evidence deadline: 2026-04-16T20:00Z. Please upload via portal.

lina_support: Support ticket #55864 attached a convo. Cardholder says: "I was charged for a subscription but never received any files or downloads. Merchant on my statement shows 'Whisp AI' — I don't know them." Agent replied: "This is a recurring charge for Redwood Inference Premium (subscription id sub_77a), you should have access to API keys and dashboard. Check billing email." Cardholder: "I never got any billing email or login link."

harry_payments: Weird — our merchant descriptor should be REDWOOD*INFERENCE. Looks like the marketplace partner uses a different descriptor. That could explain "unknown merchant" complaints. Need receipts, email delivery logs, subscription activation logs, and marketplace partner agreement showing descriptor mapping.

isha_fraud: Triage notes:
- BIN: benign
- Velocity: single large monthly charge, no rapid repeats
- Billing email mismatches: billing_email_sent flag=false for this subscription (we attempted send but SES returned 554 bounce on 2026-03-30)
- Access logs: we have API activity for sub_77a on 2026-03-29 11:05Z from ip 3.129.12.8 (EU region), but no UI logins.
- Descriptor mismatch increases chance of 'friendly fraud' or merchant confusion.
Assessment: medium-low fraud suspicion; likely cardholder confusion due to marketplace descriptor. Recommend evidence + merchant statement + email delivery attempt logs + subscription activation screenshot.

marketplace-eng: FYI — this came through partner Whisperia (marketplace id mp_whisperapps). They requested descriptor 'Whisp AI' for marketplace purchases per their onboarding form. Our contract requires we append 'via Redwood' but partner opted in for bespoke descriptor. I'll pull the marketplace onboarding doc and the ACH/descriptor mapping sheet.

acct-bot: Automated: invoice INV-2026-03-29-1142 generated for sub_77a amount $89.00. Receipt email attempt log: SES send_id=sgk-3302, status=bounced, bounce_code=554, bounce_reason=domain not found.

harry_payments: OK collectables:
- Invoice PDF (INV-2026-03-29-1142) — I can attach
- Receipt email headers and bounce details (acct-bot)
- Subscription activation + API access log (isha)
- Marketplace onboarding doc showing descriptor mapping (marketplace-eng)
- Merchant statement: signed letter from finance confirming merchant relationship and descriptor mapping (Isha/hp to draft)

lina_support: Customer provided screenshot of bank statement showing 'Whisp AI' and a note: "I don't recognize this charge". I'll include screenshot in packet. Also they sent a support DM attempting to contact Whisperia — include that attempt.

isha_fraud: Technical evidence snippet (redacted):
```
subscription_id: sub_77a
last_api_call: 2026-03-29T11:05:12Z
ip: 3.129.12.8
user_agent: Redwood-Server/2.1
email_bounce: true
ses_send_id: sgk-3302
```
We will hash user identifiers for privacy (sha256) unless processor insists on raw values.

marketplace-eng: Opening partner ticket PMT-2026-141 to ask Whisperia to confirm their descriptor and share any customer-facing emails they sent. ETA 1 business day.

harry_payments: Action plan: Lina assemble support convo + bank screenshot. Isha include access logs + SES delivery attempt and signed merchant statement. Marketplace-eng to attach onboarding doc and partner response. I'll assemble the merchant declaration PDF and upload. Aim to submit by 2026-04-16T18:00Z to be safe.

processor-bot: Reminder: Missing merchant statement will likely lead to provisional credit to cardholder. Upload portal: https://proc-portal.example.com/cases/PC-2026-APR-447

lina_support: Copy. Uploading support export now.

isha_fraud: Note for evidence packet: include hash of API key used and redacted IPs; add proof of service = API response logs and quota usage showing the account had provisioned features.

harry_payments: I'll draft the merchant statement: one-paragraph confirming service provided, subscription dates, descriptor explanation (Whisp AI = marketplace descriptor for partner Whisperia, charges processed via Redwood Inference). Will sign and include contact for dispute.

marketplace-eng: Partner responded: they did not send any emails to the cardholder. They confirm descriptor is 'Whisp AI' and accept they'll update their customer communications. Attaching partner response in ticket PMT-2026-141.

harry_payments: Great. Submitting packet now. I'll post the portal reference when done. If processor asks for raw email address or full prompt content we need legal approval; flagging legal now. :eyes:

processor-bot: Evidence uploaded by merchant (receipt, invoice, support transcript, merchant statement, SES bounce logs) at 2026-04-16T16:42Z. Case status: evidence submitted.

lina_support: Thanks team. I'll follow up if processor pushes for more. Cardholder may still be refunded depending on issuer.

harry_payments: Closing loop: Update billing flow to force descriptor 'REDWOOD*INFERENCE' for marketplace charges by next week, and require receipt resend if bounce detected. Filing prod ticket now (PAY-2026-889).
